nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set from msg.sender and used as access-control authority.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
ERC20 token symbol, set to SOUP in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to Chicken Soup Protocol in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Total token supply; totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] from it.
Blocked recipient address used by the 'please wait' transfer restriction logic.
Mapping of account balances used by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping used by approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Internal checked addition helper (c = a + b, require(c >= a)).
Internal checked subtraction helper (require(b <= a)).
Internal checked multiplication helper.
Internal checked division helper (require(b > 0)).
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and commits owner.
onlyOwner function in ChickenSoupProtocol that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
ERC20 transfer; blocks 'to' when it equals newun and moves balances for msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom; sets newun on first use when from != 0, otherwise enforces the newun restriction, then moves balances and allowances.
ERC20 approve; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Approves spender and then invokes the external receiveApproval callback on the spender contract.
onlyOwner setter for the newun blocked-address state variable.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender.
Initializes symbol, name, decimals, supply and the owner's balance.
Sets owner = msg.sender on deployment.
External contract callback entry point invoked by approveAndCall on an attacker-controlled address.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts on direct Ether sends.
Empty payable fallback that accepts Ether which clearCNDAO can later drain.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and Ether withdrawal.
Untrusted external call in approveAndCall to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval before state is settled, enabling reentrancy.
address.transfer of the entire contract balance to msg.sender inside clearCNDAO; external Ether send out of an onlyOwner drain function.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates clearCNDAO on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transfernewun on msg.sender == owner.
transfer uses balances[msg.sender] as the debited account.
transferFrom uses allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
TokenERC20 constructor credits balances[owner] which originated from msg.sender.
Owned constructor derives owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes the recipient of the Ether transfer in clearCNDAO, allowing an external call back into the contract.
approveAndCall reaches the untrusted external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval.
The external receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall/transfer paths before completion.
Attacker-controlled receiveApproval implementation callback reaches back into the token contract.
clearCNDAO passes the local owner address into the Ether transfer operation.
Ether transfer to msg.sender is an external interaction that may re-enter clearCNDAO.
transfer 'tokens' parameter feeds the unchecked-by-compiler SafeMath subtraction/addition on balances.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter feeds the SafeMath sub/add operations on balances and allowances.
approve 'tokens' value is stored directly into the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall 'tokens' value is stored into the allowance mapping and forwarded to the callback.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub twice on balances and allowances.
totalSupply calls SafeMath.sub(_totalSupply, balances[address(0)]).
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit balances[to].
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit balances[to].
transfer 'to' parameter is used for the newun check and as credit recipient.
transferFrom 'from' parameter is debited and used in the newun branch.
transferFrom 'to' parameter is credited and checked against newun.
approve 'spender' parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall 'spender' parameter indexes the allowance mapping and becomes the callback target.
approveAndCall 'data' parameter is forwarded to the external callback.
transferOwnership writes the supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
transfernewun writes the supplied _newun into the newun state variable.
receiveApproval 'from' parameter is part of the external callback signature.
receiveApproval 'tokens' parameter is part of the external callback signature.
receiveApproval 'token' parameter is part of the external callback signature.
receiveApproval 'data' parameter is part of the external callback signature.
clearCNDAO local _owner is assigned msg.sender inside the function.
clearCNDAO local _owner is the recipient address of the external Ether transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom can set newun = to when from != address(0) and newun is unset, allowing an arbitrary caller to seed the block list.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external call.
transfernewun writes the newun state variable.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership updates the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner state variable.
